root_cause: The native-host image service received the container mount root, so the governed F-drive input was remapped to a path that does not exist in the host process.
Docker Desktop file-SD propagation retained the last S7 target after an empty target set was written; HTTP reload alone did not converge target removal.
remediation: Bind both host and mount roots to the resolved host data root for native-host serving.
Persist an explicit empty file-SD target set, fail closed on a stale preflight target, and restart only the local Prometheus container when bind-mount notification does not converge.
Record exact B0, lease, CUDA inference, Prometheus, and S7 target cleanup even when a diagnostic fails.
claim_boundary: Rejected local single-node diagnostic with zero S7 acceptance credit; no production, SLA, HA/DR, multi-GPU, or broad model-quality claim.
